knowledge_answers.rationale: Only a nominated player may bat or act as a runner.
Except for the final innings, a batting captain may declare during the innings when the ball is dead; an innings may be forfeited before it commences, and notification is final.
The umpires control the match balls and the replacement process; a lost or unfit ball is replaced by one whose wear is comparable to the ball before replacement, not automatically by a new ball.

knowledge_answers.rationale: The dangerous or unfair short delivery is called No ball; the previous first-and-final warning makes this a further offence; the bowler is immediately suspended from bowling for the innings and an eligible bowler completes the over if needed.

The No-ball penalty stands separately; an overthrow boundary adds the boundary allowance to completed runs and the crossed run in progress; because the ball was struck, those six non-penalty runs belong to the striker and the failed attempt supplies no dismissal.
